provenance: One pre-registered study so far: 320 scored cells across five models at temperature 0 (October 2026). The study was registered by commit before its first scored run (hypotheses, corpus, synthesized fixture, and graders all committed first) and published as found, gate letters included. The fixture is 16 hand-authored chord progressions (440 bars, known chords by construction) rendered to audio by deterministic synthesis and transcribed by Spotify Basic Pitch with the production app's exact model files and thresholds, so the model reads the same noisy transcription the shipped feature reads. Prompt texts are the production app's verbatim, pinned by test; grading is mechanical (root pitch class plus canonical quality); and every call shape matches production, including two registered amendments: call-shape fixes for two models whose first run produced no scorable cells, and an 80-cell re-run of the shipped arm after Stem Shovel adopted the study's matcher fix in v0.142.0.
footer: Pre-registered briefs, the corpus, the synthesis and grading code, and all analyses live in the stem-bench repository (BRIEF.md, REPORT.md). The product under test is Stem Shovel, Lightning Jar's music collaboration app. Sibling programs: AEO Bench and Barkup Bench.
